AMBIANCE
Pastel shades, colorful wall murals, gorgeous wall mirrors and little frames - aptly describing my love for desserts 😋 Exactly a place you want to spend your afternoons, watching the rain pour outside 🌧️

FOOD

#yummy

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
10 January 2020- 20.00 hours
"All-Natural ice-creams"

This is not the first time I visited TIB (The Ice-cream Bakery). I have been here numerous times since its inception. I wish I had all the pictures of all the times I have been here. I would have had hundreds of pictures. I love this place so much so that when I am around, I go nowhere but to TIB for desserts. They are a small outlet located at the Versova junction and served phenomenal desserts.

The staff is super talented and quick. At our most recent visit we were attended by Manager - Satish and the support staff were Bharat and Nitish. The support staff were super quick the manager had a solid grasp over the skills needed to decorate the desserts and cakes. Most of the presentation you will see in the pictures are done by him. Some of the items you should try here are Chocolate Ice-creams, Ice Cream Strawberry, Milky Way, Dark Chocolate Ice Cream & Brownie.

Desserts

Let's discuss all that we had at TIB. The first one that we tried is called NEWYORKERS. It is called so because it is made by squashing the New York cheesecake along with the secret mixture which is milk like in appearance. Here they take  a piece of cheesecake and mix it with the milk like mixture and blend it into a scoop of this super soft and cheesy ice-cream. It is must try for the cheesecake lovers.

Another one is called a type of shooter which is their term for multi-layered ice-cream mousse. The dessert was called - GLOSSY CHOCOLATE SHOOTER. Here you get a multi-layered ice-cream mouse which involves layers of liquidy chocolate ice-cream, dark chocolate ganache and powdered brownie. The layers looked and tasted scrumptious.

Addition to the taste, the way Bharat was setting up the layers was fascinating. The liquidy chocolate was so chocolaty that you feel like you are having a melted cold chocolate. Next up was a sundae called DARK NIGHT SUNDAE. Satish almost completely prepared this. This sundae is served in a Martini glass and includes two dark chocolate scoops, Nutella biscuit powder, Butterscotch crunch, Oreo biscuit powder, Bourbon biscuit, Chocolate sticks and whip cream.

Are you tired of reading the ingredients of the Sundae? Let me tell you I have not mentioned the rainbow sprinkles and chocolate sauce added to the dessert at the end. It is a wholesome dessert and made to be shared and so we did. All the contents were added perfectly and decorated beautifully. You should give it a try to see how good of a sundae it is. It is absolutely worth the price.

After having so much of chocolate we wanted to have something fruity and what better than Strawberry in this season could satisfy our cravings? We ordered strawberry in scoop; it was made live as they do for almost everything. The taste was perfectly berriesh. The conclusion was extremely satisfying. The only recommendation could be to make the ambiance and seating a little organized. Rest all is perfect.

If you have a sweet tooth and crave something chilled to beat this scorching summer heat then Ice Cream Works is a place to visit to satiate your craving. This outlet is located in Juhu opposite Ramada Plaza Hotel, very close to Juhu Beach...

The decor and the seatings are really nice, cool and comfortable. The staff is also very accomodating and helped us in choosing the right combination of flavors.
Avinash, Dharmendra & Hitesh at the counter were extremely humble, courteous and welcoming...
They have a variety of Ice Cream flavors and all are really mouth-watering.

We tried these Ice Creams during our visit :-

1) Triple cone ice cream (Mango, Pink Guava and Calcutta Meetha Paan served in a Special Waffle Cone)
Really loved the Triple Cone Ice Cream with three distinct flavours and different colours. My favourite one was Pink Guava Ice Cream as the flavour enhances when you add a pinch of salt to it and tastes really wonderful. Loved the paan flavour as well as if we were enjoying a chilled paan. The Pink Guava Ice Cream is highly recommended, must try.

2) Triple cone ice cream (Double Strawberry Chocolate Chip Ice Cream, Madagascar Fine Chocolate Ice Cream and Pink Guava served in a Chocolate Waffle Cone)
One of a kind mix of different flavours of Ice Cream that you can have. The Strawberry Chocolate Chip Ice Cream had chunks of Strawberry and Chocolate chips in it and it tasted really amazing. Chocolate Madagascar icecream is highly recommended...

3) Fruit Cocktail Tower - Served in a beautiful long glass contained the following ingredients, Scoop of Vanilla Ice Cream topped with different fruits which was ultimately topped with whipped cream and sprinkle of chocolate syrup. A really delicious Sundae Ice Cream one can devour.

4) Choco Brownie - This Sundae was served in a medium sized glass that had dollops of chocolate brownie with gooey Chocolate Ice Cream at the bottom and topped with whipped cream, choco chips and chocolate syrup drizzle. A must have Sundae Ice Cream.

5) Cookies & Coffee Shake - A Smoothie shake made of Oreo Cookies Ice Cream and splashed with a hint of coffee to give it a really nice taste. Must try for coffee lovers...

6) Ultimate Chocolate Shake - Loads of Chocolate Ice Cream blended and made a thick shake and topped with whipped cream and chocolate syrup. A nice way to beat the heat and my personal favourite.

Must visit place...
Don't miss to try their unique pink guava and chocolate Madagascar icecream...
